headline: OpenAI launches Grid Protectors and cites a large flexible-load agreement for its planned Georgia campus
summary: OpenAI announced Grid Protectors on 2 November 2026 as a program to arrange flexible power use at future compute campuses. It cites a Georgia Power agreement for a planned Effingham County campus that the utility says could require about 3,200 MW and allow up to 1,000 MW of demand response under a 25-year term. The program and contract terms are first-party/utility claims; the campus is not yet operating. A Georgia PSC filing shows consumer and environmental groups requested additional enforceable safeguards and disclosure for the redacted contract. The Georgia PSC docket page checked on 3 November still lists docket 44280 as open, shows no filing rows, and provides no result or order for the Oct 29 hearing. Actual curtailment, avoided infrastructure and customer savings remain unmeasured.
